200.description:
One catalogue record by id, name or page URL (CKAN package_show): a publication's or data set's title, description, ministry, creators, licence, issue/created/modified dates, publication type, topics, tags, subjects, audience, language, series, coverage, update frequency, identifiers (ISBN, ISSN, catalogue keys), replaces/replaced-by and translation links, and every resource (edition or file) with its download URL, format, size and dates. Unknown ids are not_found.

The response contains the tool result directly.

value.notes: This Alberta Official Statistic compares the life expectancy of Alberta and Alberta Health Services Continuum Zones (South, Calgary, Central, Edmonton, North) by sex for 2014. Life expectancy is the number of years a person would be expected to live if the age- and sex- specific mortality rates for a given observation period were held constant.

post.description: Start here to find a publication or data set, count records ("how many bathymetric survey publications"), or list what changed ("modified_since", "sort: updated"). Use type publications for documents and opendata for data sets; organization takes a ministry slug from list_organizations or facets.organization[].name.

cursor.description: Result offset to resume from: the next_cursor of the previous page. Pattern: ^[0-9]{1,9}$.

license_id.description: Licence id: OGLA (Open Government Licence - Alberta), KPTU (King's Printer Terms of Use), OGNL (no licence).

modified_since.description: Only records whose catalogue entry changed on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD); use with sort updated to poll for new and updated records. Pattern: ^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$.

organization.description: Ministry or agency slug, e.g. health, energy-and-minerals, service-alberta-and-red-tape-reduction. Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$.

pubtype.description: Publication type, e.g. Report, Fact Sheet, Guide, Orders and Directives, Legislation and Regulations, Media Release, Statistics (facets.pubtype[].name).

q.description: Full-text query (Solr syntax allowed: quotes, AND/OR). Omit to list everything.

res_format.description: Resource format a record must offer, e.g. PDF, CSV, XLSX, XML.

rows.description:
Records per page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 20.

sort.description:
relevance (default with q), modified (content date, default without q), issued (newest publication date), updated (catalogue entry change), title (A-Z).

Provider reference: allowed values ["relevance", "modified", "issued", "updated", "title"].

tag.description: Keyword tag, exact as stored (e.g. registry agents).

topic.description: Topic, e.g. Environment, Health and Wellness, Laws and Justice (facets.topic[].name).

type.description:
Record type: publications (documents), opendata (data sets), documentation (portal help), or any.

Provider reference: allowed values ["publications", "opendata", "documentation", "any"]; default "any".

200.description:
Search the Open Alberta catalogue (CKAN package_search): ~34.5k Government of Alberta publications (reports, fact sheets, guides, ministerial orders, legislation, statistics, media releases) and ~3k open data sets in one index. Full-text query plus record type, ministry, topic, publication type, tag, format, licence and issue/update date filters, sorted and paged. Returns record cards with every resource (download URLs, formats, dates), the total count and the top facet values.

The response contains the tool result directly.

The provider identifies `results` as the primary payload key.
